main_body: Red slot machine cabinet (about rows 6-29) with a gold/yellow sign header at the top, a reel window with red/white reels, a coin tray and a lower panel, all painted on a flat front face; a lever on the right side.
top_band: Rows 1-4 are a gold/tan header band that reads as a sign panel on the front face, not a horizontal top surface. There is no distinct lighter top surface above a front edge; the red body starts directly at row 6.
evidence: Reading a column through the middle: the gold band at rows 1-4 (with a white/orange light strip at rows 4-5) is a vertical marquee. Below it a dark band, then the red front with the reel window, tray and panel. All details (reels, coin slot, tray) are painted flat on the face. No foreshortened top surface is visible, and there is no eave shadow or inset front. This is a straight front elevation, like the red 'front elevation' guide examples.

style.evidence: The red body is mostly large flat fills, with 2-3 tones in red, gold and brown. There is little grain or texture compared with the stall and well references, which have 5-6 steps and per-element highlights. The outer frame is dark brown, but the inner shapes have a hard dark edge. Tiles carry few colours, so the piece is thinner than the references.
